analysis_sequence: Run and publish the frozen MNQ 1-minute vwap_delta_rejection primary first.
Seal the primary verdict before inspecting alternative-strategy outcomes.
Then use the same data as development evidence for non-depth alternatives.
Any newly selected alternative requires a later untouched holdout.
limitations: This is a more recent budget-constrained replication, not the full 2023-2026 preregistered replication.
Depth-dependent strategies cannot be validated from these requests.
The guarded downloader refuses submission if the current metadata estimate exceeds $95.
